examples.question: Show gross revenue by month.
examples.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', orders.ordered_at) AS order_month, sum(orders.total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM commerce.orders AS orders GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month;

examples.question: Calculate net revenue.
examples.sql: SELECT sum(orders.total_cents) - coalesce(sum(refunds.amount_cents) FILTER (WHERE refunds.status = 'succeeded'), 0) AS net_revenue_cents FROM commerce.orders AS orders LEFT JOIN commerce.payments AS payments ON payments.order_id = orders.order_id LEFT JOIN commerce.refunds AS refunds ON refunds.payment_id = payments.payment_id;

examples.question: Count completed orders by customer region.
examples.sql: SELECT customers.region, count(*) AS completed_orders FROM commerce.orders AS orders JOIN commerce.customers AS customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE orders.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY customers.region ORDER BY customers.region;

examples.question: Show gross revenue by product category.
examples.sql: SELECT categories.name AS category_name, sum(order_items.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM commerce.order_items AS order_items JOIN commerce.products AS products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id JOIN commerce.categories AS categories ON products.category_id = categories.category_id GROUP BY categories.name ORDER BY category_name;

examples.question: Show succeeded refund amount by reason.
examples.sql: SELECT refunds.reason, sum(refunds.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM commerce.refunds AS refunds WHERE refunds.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY refunds.reason ORDER BY refunds.reason;

examples.question: Average delivery time by carrier.
examples.sql: SELECT shipments.carrier, avg(shipments.delivered_at - shipments.shipped_at) AS average_delivery_time FROM commerce.shipments AS shipments WHERE shipments.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND shipments.delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY shipments.carrier ORDER BY shipments.carrier;
